meaning: CommitReceipt exports only target path, previous digest, committed digest, transaction ID.
FileCommitPort and FileWriteLease expose acquire/read/replace, no issuer lookup or lease-proof getter.
StdFileCommit acquires a boxed lease; native sidecar handle is private and owned by lease.
regular_identity calls GetFileInformationByHandle and checks attributes/link count; returns unit, not volume/file identity evidence.
Acquire uses sidecar share_mode(0), validates sidecar, reads target, inspects journal, retains handle.
CAS compares previous digest; journal records target/digests/transaction/state, not Ready issuer context.
Publish rechecks prior digest, verifies bytes, commits journal, constructs the four-field receipt.
HOST checks target/prior/new digest and 32 lowercase-hex transaction ID, not native lease provenance.
HOST obtains lease and reads current contents locally.
Lease scope closes before result proof construction; returned commit receipt is not evidence of a continuing held lease.
